description: This file provides database connection utilities for a Python application, including functions to get a database URL from environment variables, establish a connection with context management, and perform a connectivity test.

methods.name: str _get_database_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the Postgres database URL from environment variables, raising an error if not set.

methods.name: Generator[psycopg.Connection,None,None] get_db_connection()
methods.description: A context manager that yields a psycopg3 database connection with a dictionary row factory, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: Optional[str] try_connect()
methods.description: Performs a quick test of database connectivity, returning None if successful or an error string if not.
